**Vladimir Karalić** ([Serbian Cyrillic]: Bлaдимиp Kapaлић; born 22 March 1984) is a Bosnian former professional [footballer] who played as a [forward] "Forward (association football)").

Karalić has represented [Bosnia and Herzegovina national team] once in 2007.

## Club career

[[edit]]

### Sun Pegasus

[[edit]]

On 11 January 2013, Karalić joined [Hong Kong First Division League] club [Sun Pegasus] from [Rudar Prijedor] for an undisclosed fee. After the season ended, Karalić was released by [Sun Pegasus].

## International career

[[edit]]

Karalić has made an appearance for the [Bosnia and Herzegovina national team] in a [friendly match] against [Poland] on 15 December 2007.[[1]]

## Personal life

[[edit]]

His father [Slobodan Karalić] was a professional football player.[[2]]
